title: Correct canonical binding reader query capacity, disjoint union, and deterministic cutoff tie-breaking
summary: Corrects canonical binding reader query capacity in services/telemetry/ingest_svc.py following genuine FE readiness rejection (Run 38180670594, FE 38183581764 rejected_before_switch at 23:35:24Z with TimeoutError in lifecycle projector bff.strict_health.pre_candidate). Failing-window PostgreSQL canonical binding queries were canceled at 23:35:14, 23:35:21, and 23:35:27Z, and advisory lock canceled at 23:35:19.983Z. Exact blocker PID and full projector traceback were not retained after original compensation, so correlation is distinguished from proven cause, and 172% CPU was recorded at 23:42:00Z after compensation rather than during the 23:35:24Z window. The query capacity is corrected by replacing the previous single GIN OR query with a mutually disjoint dual-branch indexed UNION: branch 1 uses the existing B-tree index idx_telemetry_events_binding_id (payload->>'binding_id' = $1 AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'binding_id') = 'string' AND (payload->>'runtime_binding_id' IS NULL OR payload->>'runtime_binding_id' = $1)), which exclusively handles all events with binding_id = $1 (including bothalias); branch 2 uses GIN index idx_telemetry_events_payload_gin exclusively for sparse runtime_binding_id events where binding_id is absent (payload @> jsonb_build_object('runtime_binding_id', $1::text) AND payload->>'binding_id' IS NULL). This eliminates overlapping bothalias scans and disallows root=$1 in branch 2 (addressing Review Finding 6). Deterministic cutoff tie-breaking is enforced by ORDER BY created_at DESC, ingested_seq DESC LIMIT ... on both inner branches and outer subquery. On the actual VM cold historical rb-52 dataset (4.56M estimated rows, 10GB) at 2026-10-12T00:04:16Z, Root measured: Candidate 0.837205s vs Original 2.076073s for 50 rows (same 50 event ID set, same event time multiset, difference in ordered IDs purely due to candidate's deterministic ingested_seq DESC tie-breaking). Test suite test_14 in services/telemetry/test_main_routes.py seeds 120 valid events and verifies 50-cutoff, 100-cutoff, limit=200 clamping, deterministic tie-breaking, malformed integer and lowercase JSON boolean ('true'/'false') fail-closed extraction, dualalias conflict negatives, and tenant isolation. Net production lines diff in services/telemetry/ingest_svc.py is exactly +1 line (strictly within <= 10 budget). AC6 is marked pending_delivery until genuine assigned reviewer exact-head review, required 3 CI checks, dev merge by integrator, and native finish.

Failing-window statement cancellations occurred at 23:35:14/21/27Z and advisory lock cancel at 23:35:19.983Z. However, exact blocker PID and full projector traceback were not retained after original compensation, so correlation is distinguished from proven cause. CPU utilization of 172% was recorded at 23:42:00Z after compensation rather than during the 23:35:24Z failing window.
